label: content
text: We will ensure that the data obtained and this study will be made available to the research community.

label: content
text: This Data Management Plan addresses the NSF policy that primary data “commonly accepted in the scientific community as necessary to validate research findings” be made available at little or no cost to the PI or project.

label: section
text: 3. Data and Metadata Format and Contents

label: content
text: We will make the proposed nano-vesicles (NETs) available to interested investigators who would like to use them in their scientific research.

label: content
text: Materials will be searchable through a number of databases and search engines, including Google and Google Scholar.

label: content
text: All materials will contain acknowledgement of NSF support as per NSF policy: “ This material is based upon work supported by the National Science Foundation under Grant No. (NSF grant number). ”

label: content
text: It is understood that the NSF Engineering Directorate requires data to be made available for a minimum of three years after conclusion of the award or public release, whichever is later.
